subject: U3: routes/meta.js — grouped /workspaces + named POST /workspace + /workspace/add-repo
description:
Restore and upgrade the workspace HTTP surface in routes/meta.js to consume U2's ctx contract (now merged on orch/feature/ws-registry: ctx.loadRegistry bound to WORKSPACES_FILE → grouped v2 registry, ctx.repoToWorkspace, ctx.workspaceForRepo(repoPath), ctx.repoRoot). Sole owner of routes/meta.js.

Background: U2 changed workspaces.json to v2 grouped shape. routes/meta.js:~209 still reads WORKSPACES_FILE behind an `Array.isArray` guard, so it now SILENTLY SKIPS the registry source. This task restores it via the ctx contract.

Changes:
1. POST /workspace (~routes/meta.js:100-108): accept optional `b.workspace` (named group) alongside `b.path` (repo). If b.path isn't already a .graph/.git root, resolve it through ctx.repoRoot first so a deep cwd registers the REPO, not a subdir. Pass the named group into setWorkspace(repoRoot, { ...b, workspace }).
2. NEW POST /workspace/add-repo { workspace, repo } → registry.addRepo (+ warm overlay/merge-driver like setWorkspace does). Explicit "register a repo under a named workspace" op without binding a session.
3. GET /workspaces (~196-250): change response to GROUPED shape `workspaces: [{ name, repos: [{ path, name, current }], current }]`. Replace the Array.isArray flat-array read (~209) with ctx.loadRegistry. Keep the per-repo existence/worktree filters (~236-241). Sources 3-5 (sessions/agents/graphStore dirs ~216-226) now contribute REPOS — attach each to its workspace via ctx.repoToWorkspace; bucket orphan repos (in graphStore but not the registry) under a synthetic "(unregistered)" group. `current` = the repo matching ?workspace=. ADD a `?flat=1` back-compat mode returning the OLD [{path,name,current}] shape so the not-yet-updated dashboard (U6) still works during rollout.

Read the ACTUAL current routes/meta.js around those lines first (drifted by U2's ctx additions). Study how ctx is passed into route handlers. Run test/workspaces-daemon.test.js + test/per-repo-workspace-scoping.test.js against the feature worktree and confirm green (note: U7 will further update tests — your job is to not regress them). Do NOT touch daemon.js, mcp-graph.js, hooks, CLI, or public/graph.html (U6).

summary: U3 done (routes/meta.js, sole owner). Consumed U2 ctx: loadRegistry/repoToWorkspace/repoRoot. (1) POST /workspace now resolves a deep cwd UP to its repo root via repoRoot before setWorkspace, and accepts optional b.workspace group name — but climbs ONLY to a strict ancestor that isn't a container root (os.tmpdir/homedir/fs-root), so a fresh top-level workspace dir is never re-homed onto an incidental ancestor .graph. (2) NEW POST /workspace/add-repo {workspace,repo} -> registry.addRepo + warms overlay/merge-driver, no session bind. (3) GET /workspaces default now returns GROUPED shape [{name, repos:[{path,name,current}], current}] via ctx.loadRegistry (v1->v2 auto-migrate); repos from sessions/agents/graphStore attach to their workspace via repoToWorkspace; repos not in registry bucket under synthetic "(unregistered)" group; per-repo existence/.graph/worktree filters kept; current = repo matching ?workspace=. Added ?flat=1 returning OLD [{path,name,current}] shape for U6 compat. Tests: per-repo-workspace-scoping.test.js 41/41 PASS. workspaces-daemon.test.js now 18/13 (13 fails are EXPECTED: it asserts the old FLAT shape on the default endpoint, which the spec deliberately changed to grouped) — flat compat verified working via ?flat=1; orphan bucket + v1 migration verified via probe. U7 must update workspaces-daemon.test.js to the grouped shape (or point its assertions at ?flat=1).
